offers_products.reason: Sells FortiGate firewalls, network security appliances and software; hardware and software are core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Sells FortiGuard security subscriptions, support contracts, and cloud-delivered security services alongside hardware.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are enterprises, service providers and governments buying network security through channel partners.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells firewalls and security subscriptions to enterprises, service providers, government agencies and small businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Security subscriptions and support renewals make up the larger share of revenue versus one-time hardware sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cybersecurity and support renewals are mission-critical and rarely cut in downturns, though hardware refreshes can be delayed.

big_ticket.reason: Appliances and annual subscriptions are moderate, frequently renewed purchases rather than large infrequent ones.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from security hardware, software and threat-intelligence technology, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large enterprises, service providers and governments, though many small businesses buy via channel.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs security appliances and software with outsourced manufacturing; no heavy plants or fleets needed to grow.
